answers.how: The block’s front edge spans about 489 pixels. The ruler gives approximately 42 pixels per cm, so 489/42 ≈ 11.6 cm.
The block’s front-face thickness is about 100 pixels; dividing by approximately 42 pixels per cm gives 2.4 cm.
The pencil tip moves approximately 550 pixels from 2.28 s to 3.40 s. Its average speed is 550/(1.12 × 42) ≈ 11.7 cm/s.
The saw blade advances approximately 510 pixels from 7.96 s to 17.08 s. Using the ruler scale, its average speed is 510/(9.12 × 42) ≈ 1.33 cm/s.
